Subject: Next steps: schedule technical deep dive (60-90m) + pre-call checklist

Hi Kai,

Thanks again for the time this morning — really useful to understand how HelioTech is planning to put LLM-based summarization into your FieldOps product. To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule the technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML/infra engineers and your engineering leads.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Wed 31 Jul, 09:00–10:30
- Thu 01 Aug, 13:00–14:30
- Fri 02 Aug, 10:00–11:30

Suggested agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m — goals & success metrics (you)
2) 20–30m — current infra, dataset shapes, perf targets (your infra/ML)
3) 20–30m — Redwood serving architecture, batching, KV cache, quantization options
4) 10–20m — integration & rollout plan, security/questions

Pre-call asks (short):
- Confirm preferred slot and timezone for each attendee.
- Who from HelioTech will bring infra/ML (names + emails).
- A quick note on dataset size (total tokens/examples) and desired 95p latency for inference.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a brief precall readout — nothing heavy. If any of the proposed slots don't work, send 2–3 alternatives and well adjust.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[lukas.meyer@redwood.com]

Attachment: tdx_precall_prereads.pdf (PDF)

On Wed 31 Jul 09:00 PDT — confirmed from my side. Quick infra ballpark: for inference-only evaluation of a ~1.2B-token dataset run (batch=8, seq_len=128) you can expect: 
- GPU: single A40 or A100-class card for model serving during the run (if you use continuous batching, throughput improves).
- RAM: ~48–64GB host RAM to stage data and handle preprocessing pipelines.
- Disk: 500GB temp for sharded dataset slices + caching.

Well bring a short slide summarizing these assumptions to the call and include a recommended profiling checklist so HelioTech can validate infra availability ahead of the run.

See you on Wednesday.

-Neha
